text: {"label":"Reinforcer Delay and Uncertainty in Choice","definition":"Experimental and translational studies of how reinforcer delay, rate, probability, and conditioned reinforcers shape choice, including impulsive, risky, and suboptimal choice and preference for choice, often with human participants.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike general reinforcement principles, quantitative models of choice allocation and changeover, or delay effects on single-response rates, this topic examines how specific reinforcer parameters bias preference between alternatives."}
